Public synthetic fixtures generated by `scripts/generate_test_materials.py`.
`native.pdf` has two physical pages: “First page evidence.” and “Second page evidence.”
`encrypted.pdf` uses only the synthetic password `fixture-password` and must be rejected.
`scanned-bilingual.pdf` embeds a small raster with English and Chinese; native parsing
must request OCR, never invent its text. The PNG permits direct visual inspection.
`headings-table.docx` contains a heading, an indented Chinese/English paragraph,
and a two-row table. These originals contain no user or corpus material.
